selection_rule: All remaining unheld C and C++ records, at all lengths, after a metadata-only repository-family hold; no substitutions.

metadata_only_family_hold.basis: The selected path explicitly names a svcomp test-case directory; conservative lineage/evaluation-coverage hold, not a proven match to the intended scoring suite. No task text displayed or semantically reviewed.

findings: Template instantiation, custom macros, SDK types and interface headers require context. An explicitly unfinished tutorial and a custom negative-index array contract should not be judged as ordinary standalone C++.

A map comparison suite omits size equality, dereferences end iterators and times the custom map again in a block labelled for the standard map. These tests do not establish independent correctness or efficiency evidence.

A vector test reuses pre-operation conversions for non-mutation checks; compiler-test helpers narrow numeric results before comparison. Coverage depends on helper semantics, ABI and actual assertion targets.

Static defects include unreachable numeric-conversion branches, self-assignment/lifetime concerns, uninitialized parser accumulators, an unsafe blink-removal loop and an unterminated palindrome buffer.

A polynomial exponentiation loop never multiplies by its base; numeric template max/min assignments target const references. No compiler, sanitizer, mathematical oracle or cryptographic result was measured.

Vendored framework tests and exported-project SDK code require upstream/version/notice attribution distinct from host repository labels. No previously verified origins are available for this batch in the chained receipts.
